records.subject: Oxygen activity
records.conditions: Polycrystalline Ta-doped TiO2 (0.39 at.% Ta); measured in situ at 1173–1323 K in gas with oxygen activity 10^−12–10^5 Pa; interpreted in terms of defect disorder

records.subject: Synthesis performed in this study
records.quote: In this work, four polymers based on diketopyrrolopyrrole (DPP), 2,3-dihydrothieno[3,4-b][1,4]dioxine (EDOT), thieno[3,2-b]thiophene (TT), and 3, 3 '-bis (2-(2-(2-methoxyethoxy) ethoxy) ethoxy)-2, 2 '-bithiophene (MEET) are investigated as side-chains, with the MEET polymers newly synthesized for this study.
